mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN BO.IS_WIN = 'N' THEN '03' WHEN BO.IS_WIN = 'Y' THEN '04' ELSE '02' END isWin, BO.BID_ID bidId, BO.FINPROD_ID finprodId, FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, FP.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, FPI.TENDER_TARGET tenderTarget, FPI.TENDER_SDATE bidDateStart, FPI.TENDER_EDATE bidDateEnd, TO_CHAR(BOBP.ENTRUST_NUM/100,'fm999999990.90') bidPrinAmtStr, TO_CHAR(BO.WIN_PRIN_AMT/10000,'fm999999990.90') totalBiddingNumStr, BOBP.BID_PRICE bidPrice, BO.WIN_TYPE winType, BO.PAY_TYPE payType, BO.BID_MODLE bidModle, BO.BID_DATE bidCfmDate, FP.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, BO.PAY_DATE payDate, BO.OUR_TRADER trader, su.REAL_NAME traderStr, BO.REMARK remark, BO.COUNTER_ID counterId, MCP.COUNTER_NAME counterName, FP.CCY ccy FROM BID_ORDER BO LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON BO.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ISSUE FPI ON FPI.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT BID_ID,wm_concat(to_char(BID_PRICE,'fm999999990.99999')) BID_PRICE,SUM(EE.ENTRUST_NUM) ENTRUST_NUM from BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE BOBP LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST EE ON BOBP.ENTRUST_ID = EE.ENTRUST_ID group by BID_ID ) BOBP ON BO.BID_ID = BOBP.BID_ID LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY MCP ON MCP.COUNTER_ID = BO.COUNTER_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_USER su ON su.USER_NAME = BO.OUR_TRADER WHERE BO.BID_ID = #{bidId}

SELECT BOBP.BID_ID bidId, BOBP.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, BOBP.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, NVL(NVL(BOBP.THE_WIN_PRIN_AMT,0)/10000,TPD.SHARE_AMT) totalBidPrinamt, NVL(NVL(BOBP.THE_WIN_PRIN_AMT,0)/10000,TPD.SHARE_AMT) winPrinAmt, decode(FPI.TENDER_TARGET,'01',to_char(BOBP.BID_PRICE*100,'fm999999990.9990')||'%','02',to_char(BOBP.BID_PRICE,'fm999999990.9990')||'元','03',to_char(BOBP.BID_PRICE*10000,'fm999999990.90')||'BP') winPrice, BOBP.INV_AIM invAim, BO.DIP_TYPE dipType from BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE BOBP LEFT JOIN ( select BO.BID_ID,TPDA.ENTRUST_ID ,SUM(TPD.SHARE_AMT)/100 SHARE_AMT from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TFPDT LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD ON TFPDT.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD TPDA ON TPD.TRADE_ID = TPDA.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN BID_ORDER BO ON BO.BID_ID = TFPDT.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID GROUP BY TPDA.ENTRUST_ID,BO.BID_ID ) TPD ON TPD.ENTRUST_ID = BOBP.ENTRUST_ID AND BOBP.BID_ID = TPD.BID_ID LEFT JOIN BID_ORDER BO ON BO.BID_ID = BOBP.BID_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ISSUE FPI ON FPI.FINPROD_ID = BO.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on BOBP.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE BOBP.BID_ID = #{bidId}

SELECT t.TRADER id, t.TRADER text FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT etr_add.TRADER FROM ETR_ENTRUST_ADD etr_add INNER JOIN ETR_ENTRUST etr ON etr.ENTRUST_ID = etr_add.ENTRUST_ID UNION SELECT BID_ORDER.OUR_TRADER TRADER FROM BID_ORDER ) t
t.TRADER like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%'))
t.TRADER like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%'))
and t.TRADER is not null

SELECT COUNTER_ID id, COUNTER_NAME text, CASE WHEN COUNTER_TYPE=#{COUNTER_TYPE} THEN #{YES_NO_N} ELSE #{YES_NO_Y} END object FROM MST_COUNTER_PARTY LEFT JOIN MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO ON MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_NAME = MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO.PARTY_NAME where 1=1
AND not exists (select 1 from PTL_PORTFOLIO p where p.PORTFOLIO_ID = MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_ID) and NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_product p WHERE p.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_ID)
AND exists (select 1 from PTL_PORTFOLIO p where p.PORTFOLIO_ID = MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_ID)
AND ( MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) )
AND (MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_ID = #{initValue} OR MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_NAME = #{initValue})
AND MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_TYPE IN
#{item}
AND MST_COUNTER_PARTY.COUNTER_TYPE = #{counterType}

SELECT BO.FINPROD_ID finprodId, FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, FP.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, FP.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, BO.OUR_TRADER ouTraderId, BO.COUNTER_ID counterId, FPI.TENDER_TARGET tenderTarget, FP.CCY ccy, NVL(FPI.PAY_DATE,FPI.PAY_EDATE) payDate, FPI.TENDER_SDATE bidDateStart, FPI.TENDER_EDATE bidDateEnd, NVL(FPI.PAY_DATE,FPI.PAY_EDATE) creditorDebtDate, FPA.LISTING_DATE listingDate, BO.WIN_TYPE winType, BO.BID_MODLE bidModle, BO.PAY_TYPE payType, BO.WIN_PRIN_AMT winPrinAmt, FP.CIRCULATION_CODE circulationCode, FPI.SERI_Y_N seriYN, FP.COUPON_SPECIES couponSpecies, BO.WIN_PRIN_AMT totalBiddingNum, BO.WIN_PRICE winPrice, BO.BID_ID bidId FROM BID_ORDER BO LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON BO.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD FPA ON FPA.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ISSUE FPI ON FPI.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID WHERE BO.BID_ID = #{bidId}

SELECT BOBP.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, BOBP.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, BOBP.THE_WIN_PRIN_AMT totalBidPrinamt, BOBP.BID_PRICE bidPrice, BOBP.INV_AIM invAim, BOBP.SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId, BOBP.ACCT_NO acctNo, EE.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId FROM BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE BOBP LEFT JOIN BID_ORDER BO ON BOBP.BID_ID = BO.BID_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST EE ON EE.ENTRUST_ID = BOBP.ENTRUST_ID WHERE BO.BID_ID = #{bidId}

SELECT BRT.TOTAL_WIN_ID totalWinId, BRT.FINPROD_ID finprodId, FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, FP.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, BO.OUR_TRADER ouTraderId, BO.COUNTER_ID counterId, FPI.TENDER_TARGET tenderTarget, FP.CCY ccy, FPI.TENDER_SDATE bidDateStart, FPI.TENDER_EDATE bidDateEnd, BRT.CREDITOR_DEBT_DATE creditorDebtDate, FPA.LISTING_DATE listingDate, BRT.WIN_TYPE winType, BO.BID_MODLE bidModle, BO.WIN_PRIN_AMT/10000 totalBiddingNum, BRT.WIN_PRINAMT winPrinAmt, BRT.WIN_PRICE winPrice, BRT.SETT_FEE_AMT settFeeAmt, BRT.REMARK remark, FP.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, BO.BID_ID bidId, BRT.PAY_DATE payDate, BO.PAY_TYPE payType FROM BID_RESULT_TOTAL BRT LEFT JOIN BID_ORDER BO ON BO.BID_ID = BRT.BID_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON BO.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD FPA ON FPA.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ISSUE FPI ON FPI.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID WHERE BRT.TOTAL_WIN_ID = #{totalWinId} UNION ALL SELECT BRT.TOTAL_WIN_ID totalWinId, BRT.FINPROD_ID finprodId, FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, FP.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, BO.OUR_TRADER ouTraderId, BO.COUNTER_ID counterId, FPI.TENDER_TARGET tenderTarget, FP.CCY ccy, FPI.TENDER_SDATE bidDateStart, FPI.TENDER_EDATE bidDateEnd, BRT.CREDITOR_DEBT_DATE creditorDebtDate, FPA.LISTING_DATE listingDate, BRT.WIN_TYPE winType, BO.BID_MODLE bidModle, BO.WIN_PRIN_AMT/10000 totalBiddingNum, BRT.WIN_PRINAMT winPrinAmt, BRT.WIN_PRICE winPrice, BRT.SETT_FEE_AMT settFeeAmt, BRT.REMARK remark, FP.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, BO.BID_ID bidId, BRT.PAY_DATE payDate, BO.PAY_TYPE payType FROM WFL_BID_RESULT_TOTAL BRT LEFT JOIN BID_ORDER BO ON BO.BID_ID = BRT.BID_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON BO.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD FPA ON FPA.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ISSUE FPI ON FPI.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID WHERE BRT.TOTAL_WIN_ID = #{totalWinId}

SELECT BRD.TOTAL_WIN_ID totalWinId, BRD.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, BRD.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, BRD.TOTAL_BID_PRINAMT totalBidPrinamt, BRD.THE_WIN_PRINAMT theWinPrinAmt, BRD.ACT_WIN_PRINAMT actWinPrinamt, BRD.BID_PRICE bidPrice, BRD.WIN_PRICE winPrice, BRD.WIN_CPRICE winCprice, BRD.INT_AMT intAmt, BRD.PAY_AMT payAmt, BRD.SETT_FEE_AMT settFeeAmt, BRD.INV_AIM invAim, BRD.SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId, EE.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId, BOBR.ACCT_NO acctNo FROM BID_RESULT_DETAIL BRD LEFT JOIN BID_RESULT_TOTAL BRT ON BRD.TOTAL_WIN_ID = BRT.TOTAL_WIN_ID LEFT JOIN BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE BOBR ON BOBR.BID_ID = BRT.BID_ID AND BOBR.ENTRUST_ID = BRD.ENTRUST_ID AND BOBR.PORTFOLIO_ID = BRD.PORTFOLIO_ID AND BOBR.BID_PRICE = BRD.BID_PRICE LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST EE ON EE.ENTRUST_ID = BRD.ENTRUST_ID WHERE BRT.TOTAL_WIN_ID = #{totalWinId} UNION ALL SELECT BRD.TOTAL_WIN_ID totalWinId, BRD.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, BRD.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, BRD.TOTAL_BID_PRINAMT totalBidPrinamt, BRD.THE_WIN_PRINAMT theWinPrinAmt, BRD.ACT_WIN_PRINAMT actWinPrinamt, BRD.BID_PRICE bidPrice, BRD.WIN_PRICE winPrice, BRD.WIN_CPRICE winCprice, BRD.INT_AMT intAmt, BRD.PAY_AMT payAmt, BRD.SETT_FEE_AMT settFeeAmt, BRD.INV_AIM invAim, BRD.SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId, EE.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId, BOBR.ACCT_NO acctNo FROM WFL_BID_RESULT_DETAIL BRD LEFT JOIN WFL_BID_RESULT_TOTAL BRT ON BRD.TOTAL_WIN_ID = BRT.TOTAL_WIN_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST EE ON EE.ENTRUST_ID = BRD.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE BOBR ON BOBR.BID_ID = BRT.BID_ID AND BOBR.ENTRUST_ID = BRD.ENTRUST_ID AND BOBR.PORTFOLIO_ID = BRD.PORTFOLIO_ID AND BOBR.BID_PRICE = BRD.BID_PRICE WHERE BRT.TOTAL_WIN_ID = #{totalWinId}

SELECT A.CASH_TYPE_1 cashType1, B.VDATE vdate, B.MDATE mdate, B.VDATE_UNADJUST vdateUnadjust, B.MDATE_UNADJUST mdateUnadjust, B.PRIN_AMT prinAmt, B.INT_AMT intAmt, B.IS_PAY_INT isPayInt FROM FIN_CASH_INFO A LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN B ON A.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND A.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}

SELECT A.VDATE startDate, A.MDATE endDate, ( SELECT MIN(C.VDATE) FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN C WHERE C.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID ) firstPayDate, A.ISSUE_PRICE issuePrice, A.COUPON_SPECIES bondsType, E.BASIS basis, F.INT_TYPE intRateType, G.PAY_CYCLE yearIntRate, G.CALC_RULE calMethod, H.EXERCISE_DATE nextExeDate, H.EXERCISE_PRICE nextExercisePrice FROM FIN_PRODUCT A LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID AND B.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType} AND B.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE D ON D.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO T1 ON A.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T1.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C02' AND T1.FINPROD_TYPE = '01' left join (select FINPROD_ID, max(eff_date) as EFF_DATE from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE group by FINPROD_ID) T2 on T2.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE E ON E.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID and E.EFF_DATE = T2.EFF_DATE AND E.CASH_ID = T1.CASH_ID AND E.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' and E.IS_INITIAL = 'Y' LEFT JOIN FIN_RATE_INFO F ON F.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID AND F.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE G ON G.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID AND G.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN WHERE EXERCISE_DATE IN ( SELECT MIN(EXERCISE_DATE) FROM FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} AND EXERCISE_DATE >= #{sysDate} ) AND FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} AND EXERCISE_TYPE = #{EXEC_MODE02} AND EXERCISE_TYPE = #{EXEC_MODE01} and rownum = 1 ) H ON 1=1 WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
select from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}
select from STL_RDERS where TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}
SELECT RATE rate, BENCHMARK_ID_ACCURACY benchmarkIdAccuracy, COEFFICIENT coefficient FROM FIN_RATE_INFO WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND ROWNUM = 1
SELECT SEC_ACCT_SOURCE FROM STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO WHERE SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId}
